research_method: Read current official sources with web tools during this task; public descriptions separated from prototype evidence.

sources.title: EPD: Waste Statistics for 2024
sources.purpose_and_boundary: Printed pp. 2 and 14; 3,001 tonnes/day and approximately 29% as social context, not avoidable waste or Senplate savings.

sources.title: Department of Health: School Lunch Arrangement and Monitoring
sources.purpose_and_boundary: School-meal guidance and monitoring resources; no nutritional compliance inferred from scale readings.

sources.title: Metafoodx: Meet Metron
sources.purpose_and_boundary: Vendor-described scanning, food monitoring and supported settings; no transferred ROI or exclusivity claim.

sources.title: Controliza: AI Buffet Control
sources.purpose_and_boundary: Vendor-described IoT weighing, consumption monitoring and replenishment alerts; acknowledged overlap.

sources.title: Raspberry Pi 5 specifications
sources.purpose_and_boundary: Candidate hardware specifications; no validation of complete station power or performance.

sources.title: Orbbec Gemini 2 specifications
sources.purpose_and_boundary: Candidate RGB-D camera and USB interface; Pi SDK and operational depth quality remain to be tested.

sources.title: PyTorch: Transfer Learning for Computer Vision
sources.purpose_and_boundary: Method for fine-tuning pretrained vision models; no training results implied.

sources.title: Torchvision: MobileNetV3 Large
sources.purpose_and_boundary: Proposed pretrained model; inference workload and accuracy require experiments.

sources.title: USDA: FoodData Central API Guide
sources.purpose_and_boundary: Food reference provenance and CC0; calculations are estimates rather than chemical measurement.
